extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Rivers of India — Himalayan rivers (Ganga, Indus, Brahmaputra): originate from glaciers, perennial (flow all year), carry alluvium, fertile. Peninsular rivers (Godavari, Krishna, Narmada, Kaveri): originate from plateau/Western Ghats, seasonal (depend on monsoon), carry less sediment. Godavari is largest Peninsular river (Dakshin Ganga). (2) Climate of India — monsoon climate. Seasons: summer (March-May, hot and dry), monsoon/rainy (June-September, southwest monsoon brings heavy rain), retreating monsoon (October-November, east coast rain), winter (December-February, cool and dry). Monsoon is the most important feature of India's climate. (3) Natural vegetation — tropical rainforests (Western Ghats, North-East — heavy rainfall), deciduous forests (central India — moderate rainfall, trees shed leaves in dry season), thorn scrub (Rajasthan — very low rainfall), mountain vegetation (Himalayas — varies with altitude), mangroves (Sundarbans — salt tolerant coastal forests). (4) Soils of India — 6 types: alluvial (Northern Plains, most fertile, wheat/rice/sugarcane), black/regur (Deccan, retains moisture, cotton), red (Tamil Nadu/Karnataka, iron-rich, millets/pulses), laterite (Western Ghats, heavy rainfall leaches nutrients, tea/coffee/rubber), desert (Rajasthan, sandy and dry, bajra), mountain (Himalayas, thin and acidic, fruits/tea). Misconceptions: 'Himalayan and Peninsular rivers are the same' (Himalayan rivers are PERENNIAL fed by snow, Peninsular rivers are SEASONAL fed by monsoon rain — they are different), 'India has only one season' (India has FOUR main seasons — summer, monsoon, retreating monsoon, and winter — the monsoon is the most important), 'all soil in India is the same' (India has SIX major soil types — alluvial, black, red, laterite, desert, and mountain — each suited to different crops and found in different regions), 'black soil is best for rice' (black soil is best for COTTON because it retains moisture — alluvial soil is best for rice and wheat), 'deciduous forests are found in deserts' (deciduous forests need MODERATE rainfall and are found in central India — thorn scrub is found in dry desert areas like Rajasthan). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function IndiaClimateGame), NOT export default. Export interface IndiaClimateGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
